messages.author: 9bf5070a8dccf419
messages.subject: LOD scores
parts:
If there are two peaks on a chromosome, is it possible to print out the
LOD score for both of these peaks? When I do the summary(out.em) it
only prints the top LOD for each chromosome.

Thanks!

messages.author: f388084a0de67b60
messages.subject: Re: LOD scores
parts:
There isn't an easy way at this point. If "out.em" is your output,
you could type

out.em[out.em[,1]==3,]

to look at all of the results for chromosome 3.

karl
